learning_outcomes.text: The student will know the current legislation regarding industrial urbanism and will be able to design industrial complexes and propose and interpret geotechnical studies.

syllabus_topics: Urbanism and industrial legislation, geotechnical study of the land, infrastructure and construction projects of industrial complexes
Topic 1. Urbanism and industrial legislation: - Theory and Development of Urbanism - Urban planning legislation - Urban planning

Topic 2. Industrial Urbanism: - Industrial zones and parks. Location. - Determination of the need for mandatory studies: environmental impact study, geotechnical study, etc. - Plotting, Public open spaces and Road system.

Topic 3. Geotechnical study of the land and earthmoving: - Technical reports for determining the geotechnical characteristics of the soil: technical-constructive parameters necessary for land adequacy, design and calculation of building foundations, slope stability, etc. - Earthmoving and excavations: slopes and shoring. - Earth pressures. Earth retaining structures.
Topic 4. Infrastructures: - Integration of facilities: water supply, electricity and fuels. Telecommunications. Sanitation. Lighting. Security, etc.
Topic 5. Construction projects for industrial complexes: - Documentation related to industrial complexes: facilities, geotechnical reports, legislative reports, necessary annexes, etc.
PRACTICAL PART - Preliminary geotechnical reports: Humidity, Granulometry, Liquid and Plastic Limits and Characterization of the nature of the soil.
Final geotechnical reports: Determination of the bulk density of solid particles, Direct Shear Test and Oedometer Test.
assessment_rules: To apply the defined percentages and pass the course, a minimum of 35% of the maximum possible score must be obtained in the recoverable sections (written tests). Unpassed parts can be re-examined in subsequent calls of the course, except for practice reports and projects, which occur once per academic year. If these critical criteria are not met, the total course grade will be FAIL, with the resulting score capped at 4.5 points.
